fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using Event Viewer RecentViews
fields.name: UAC Bypass Using Event Viewer RecentViews
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\Event Viewer\\RecentViews" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\EventV~1\\RecentViews") and tgt.process.cmdline contains ">"))
